objective: Determine whether topology-based training assignment improves uniformly served predictions beyond the same reweighting with random/loss-based assignments and a structurally capable single.
outside_frozen_work: Separate new study; no edits/reuse claims for frozen NCNC J/F, initialization cohorts, covariance selector, conditional-response probe or running native studies.
representative_graph: Full ogbl-Collab, using the existing released TRAIN/raw/VALID roles and TEST lock; new authoritative protocol must be source-bound before execution.
candidate_model: One admitted shared-backbone four-member BUDDY-style structural predictor with the exact same architecture, information, fast-factor ownership and fixed serving as its uniform-training reference. No new parameters or inference gate in the candidate.

exact_changed_operation.notation: theta = all shared trainable parameters; phi_m = every member-private parameter; ell_m(q) = native per-query supervised loss; nu = the exact native TRAIN query/loss measure, including source positive/negative reductions.
exact_changed_operation.context: For each actual native minibatch, rank queries by r(q)=log(1+degree_Gq(u))+log(1+degree_Gq(v)), with deterministic endpoint-hash tie breaking, and divide into four nearly equal structural-rank cells. Gq is the public TRAIN support with the queried edge removed if present; no VALID/TEST incidence or labels enter. The model forward uses its unchanged admitted native graph. Structural rank is an input-derived training allocation, not a learned gate.
exact_changed_operation.losses: L_own=(1/4)sum_m E_nu ell_m; L_private,m=(1/4)[(1/2)E_nu ell_m+(1/2)E_(nu|cell=m) ell_m]. Each private route retains global supervision through the fixed half anchor. Native loss weights and reductions must be preserved in conditional means. Empty/tiny-cell handling must be fixed and qualified before a source packet; no native record/update may be discarded.
exact_changed_operation.update: From one identical pre-update forward state, feed g_theta=partial_theta L_own and g_phi_m=partial_phi_m L_private,m to one native optimizer transition. Preserve the original 1/4, optimizer settings/state, full budget, RNG/native query streams and checkpoint rules. This is a block-dependent vector field, generically not the gradient of one scalar objective.
exact_changed_operation.serving: Uniform native prediction pool and one family selector; no topology-dependent inference weights, member-oracle selection, new parameters or test-time view budget.

why_it_can_differ: Private cotangents emphasize different observed structural query regimes while the common body sees the same native own-member risk. This can change later parameter trajectories even with identical architecture and initial state. It does not establish complementarity, non-erasure by the shared update, pooled descent or predictive benefit.
main_failure_modes: Degree rank may be unrelated to useful prediction regimes; extensive score ties can make allocation mostly hash-based.
Private capacity and a single shared body can fit all strata better without specialization, or shared updates can erase private advantages.
Conditional risk can lower global member competence and uniform pooling can average away any specialist advantage.
The half anchor is a declared untested choice, not theory-optimal or a tuned result; the test cannot rescue it with an after-the-fact grid.
Different conditional gradient magnitudes, nonconservative block updates and native Adam moments can change optimization independently of structural relevance.
Existing target-edge/data/negative-sampler protocols and false-negative interpretation must be preserved; the method predicts observed-link supervision and does not know latent nonlink truth.

comparators.purpose: Same admitted shared four-member architecture, native unweighted own loss and serving.

Same cells sizes, anchor, normalization, backward work and one optimizer transition; replace structural order with predeclared hash assignment. This is the closest controlled comparison for graph relevance.

sMCL-derived assignment using pre-update lowest-member loss with fixed tie handling, same global anchor/shared gradient/normalization/serving. It is a declared adaptation, not a native sMCL oracle-performance reproduction.

Admit a single GPM or equally capable structural BUDDY/LPFormer predictor with access to the same graph/context information; preserve its own native budget and charge its full work. GPM's published80/5/15 Collab split/table is not compatible evidence. A same-information capable single plus a matched shared4 reference prevents a weak-scalar-head comparison.

minimum_representative_groups: Five arms including candidate, three complete paired seeds, one complete graph:15 owned run groups (four F4 arms x3 plus one single x3). There are51 complete member/single trajectories if each F4 group trains four full routes. No existing result or checkpoint was opened or designated reusable.
selection_and_readout: Prospectively bind one unchanged family-level selector, official complete VALID Hits50 and all paired seed differences. Retain final endpoint, every member competence on all VALID queries and each predeclared structural cell, global own/pool losses, error overlap and all cost/failure receipts. No TEST opening, per-member checkpoint cherry-picking or oracle-based adoption.
decisive_falsifiers: If structural assignment fails to improve served VALID quality over uniform and matched random allocation, it does not support a topology-specific quality extension.
If loss-assigned allocation explains the same gain, the graph-conditioned assignment contribution is unestablished.
If the capable single matches or exceeds served quality at comparable paid work, an ensemble-specific quality advantage is unestablished.
Better TRAIN objective, larger oracle coverage, larger member spread or favorable stratum-only metrics cannot replace the served primary comparison.
remaining_source_requirements: Pin and qualify the complete shared/private parameter inventory and admitted native family; no current BUDDY factorized implementation is claimed here.
Resolve context construction/native query ordering, exact positive/negative and conditional reductions, score-tie and small-cell behavior, same-state gradients and one optimizer/RNG transition.
Admit and harmonize the capable single source/recipe/roles before freezing comparison; do not substitute a borrowed table or tune an unsupported default after outcomes.
Measure complete one-epoch/capture/backward work, every arm peak memory and full native budget forecast before a resource decision.
resource_status: Unmeasured. No GPU-hour, memory-fit, implementation-complete or launch-ready claim; retained reverse passes/recomputation and context extraction must be included. The need for measurement is not evidence that the hypothesis is false.
